closing.title: Tell us what your business does.
closing.body: An advisor will reply and validate the configuration with you before any order.

whatIsNelias.a: NELIAS is a Business Management Platform designed to bring business management capabilities together and configure them around an organization’s profile.

isErp.a: NELIAS includes ERP-type capabilities, but its positioning is broader: a platform approach built around business profiles, sector-aware configuration and connected workflows.

sectorEngine.a: The Sector Engine is the rules-based component designed to recommend a relevant configuration from your business profile and needs.

addLater.a: The platform helps to support evolving plans, capacities and optional capabilities, subject to catalogue availability.

multipleOffices.q: Do I pay more for multiple offices?
multipleOffices.a: Physical location alone is not a pricing factor. Additional operational capabilities, legal entities or services may affect the price.

hosting.q: Where will my data be hosted?
hosting.a: Hosting options depend on the subscription and technical requirements. NELIAS is being planned with African hosting options, including Côte d’Ivoire, subject to contractual confirmation.

connect.q: Can I connect NELIAS to other tools?
connect.a: Approved connectors and APIs are planned, with availability and fees varying by integration.

getStarted.q: How do I get started with NELIAS?
getStarted.a: Select “Configure My NELIAS” to describe your business, review a recommended configuration, and proceed through the currently available options.

tryNelias.a: demo access and trial offers depend on currently available services. Contact the team to register your interest.

moreThanOneCompany.q: Can I use NELIAS for more than one company?
moreThanOneCompany.a: Multi-entity capabilities depend on the plan and any additional legal-entity subscriptions.

offices.q: Does the price depend on the number of offices or stores?
offices.a: No. Your users can connect from head office, a branch, their home or while travelling at no site charge. NELIAS charges for capacity, functional value and consumption.

includes.a: The platform, the Sector Engine, a number of standard modules ({{start}}, {{business}} or {{professional}} depending on the plan), users, storage and the service level of the plan.

moreModules.q: Can I use more modules than my plan includes?
moreModules.a: Yes. Each additional standard module costs {{amount}} excl. VAT per month.

modify.q: Can we modify the recommended modules?
modify.a: Yes. The Sector Engine recommends a selection that you can add to, remove from or replace among the compatible modules.

packsDate.q: When will the Industry+ packs be available?
packsDate.a: The schedule has not yet been set. The five packs are planned and are not yet sold. You can ask to be notified when they become available.

twoMonths.q: What does the annual “2 months free” mean?
twoMonths.a: By paying the base subscription for the year, you pay 10 months for 12 months of service.

hosted.q: Is my data hosted in Côte d’Ivoire?
hosted.a: Hosting in Côte d’Ivoire is possible with the Sovereign offer, on quote. The Shared mode is included in the START, BUSINESS and PROFESSIONAL plans.

migrate.q: Can you migrate our existing data?
migrate.a: Yes, as part of a migration service quoted according to your project.

legacy.q: Can we replace a legacy or custom system?
legacy.a: This is possible within an ENTERPRISE offer on quote, with a progressive migration and, where needed, custom development quoted separately.

currency.q: In which currency are prices shown?
currency.a: In FCFA. Display in the currency of your country is planned for a later stage.
